card.name: Urinary excretion and metabolism terms
card.fires_on: Words just before an excretion or metabolism term in pharmacokinetic text, such as "urinary", "of" after "urinary excretion", "hydro" before lytic or xy, and "par" in parathyroid.

modes.label: Urinary excretion
modes.description: The word urinary, or "of" after urinary excretion, leading to the substance excreted.
modes.example: had no effect on urinary excretion<< of>> cortisol.

modes.label: Start of chemical words
modes.description: The opening piece of a long biochemical word such as hydrolytic, hydroxy or parathyroid.
modes.example: The initial step in alprazolam metabolism is<< hydro>>xy
